manifest.name: RAMPAGE: The Climb
manifest.description: A televised survival climb up the inside of the RAMPAGE tower. Race the rising Surge 53 m to the crown: jump the lasers and sweepers, dodge crushers and fire, ride moving plates. Gold gates vent the Surge. Fastest climb tops the weekly table. A/D run, W/S wall, Space jumps, R retries; phones use the stick and JUMP.
